_readme: Hotkey Atlas built-in notes: the Note column text for Skyrim controls and mod hotkeys.
Read on every scan: after editing press Rescan (Hide mods page) or reload the game. Save as UTF-8.
Texts are English and are translated by Translations/<language>.txt like the rest of the menu.
A text can also carry its own translations: { "english": "Open the map", "russian": "Открыть карту" }.
controls: <context> -> <control event> -> text. Contexts: Gameplay, Menu, Console, ItemMenu, Inventory, DebugText,
Favorites, Map, Stats, Cursor, Book, DebugOverlay, Journal, TFC, MapDebug, Lockpicking, Marketplace, Favor, Any.
A context's own entry wins over the device one, which wins over Any. Event names ignore case, spaces and dashes.
devices: Keyboard / Mouse / Gamepad -> event -> text, for controls whose meaning depends on the device.
directions: fallback for Up / Down / Left / Right, the context's description is appended.
quickSlots: Hotkey1..Hotkey8, {0} is the slot number.
mods: notes for mod hotkeys. Each entry needs "setting" (ini setting or json path, e.g. "Menu.ToggleKey")
or "action" (the name in the Action column), plus "mod" (the Mod column) and/or "file" (path under Data,
or just the file name). "section" (the Context column) is optional. The first matching entry is used.

Gameplay.Activate: Interact: talk, open doors and containers, pick up, loot
Gameplay.Left Attack/Block: Left hand: attack, block (shield / two-hander) or cast its spell
Gameplay.Right Attack/Block: Right hand: attack or cast its spell
Gameplay.Ready Weapon: Draw or sheathe weapons and spells
Gameplay.Tween Menu: Open the Skills / Items / Map / Magic menu
Gameplay.Toggle POV: Switch first / third person; hold to orbit the camera
Gameplay.Sprint: Sprint (uses stamina); gallop on a horse
Gameplay.Shout: Use the equipped shout or power
Gameplay.Run: Hold to switch between walking and running
Gameplay.Toggle Always Run: Switch the default between walking and running
Gameplay.Auto-Move: Keep moving forward without holding a key
Gameplay.Pause: Open the system menu (save, load, settings)

Menu.Accept: Confirm the highlighted option (menus, dialogue, message boxes)
Menu.Cancel: Close the menu / go back one level
Menu.Up: Move the selection up in lists, dialogue and message boxes
Menu.Down: Move the selection down in lists, dialogue and message boxes
Menu.Left: Move the selection left / previous category
Menu.Right: Move the selection right / next category

Console.Up: Previous command in the console history
Console.Down: Next command in the console history
Console.PickPrevious: Select the previous reference under the cursor
Console.PickNext: Select the next reference under the cursor
Console.Pick: Select the reference under the cursor

ItemMenu.LeftEquip: Equip the highlighted item in the left hand
ItemMenu.RightEquip: Equip / use the highlighted item (right hand)
ItemMenu.Item Zoom: Inspect the highlighted item up close
ItemMenu.XButton: Drop the item (Inventory) / Take All (Container) / Store (Gift)
ItemMenu.YButton: Add or remove the item from Favorites

Inventory.ChargeItem: Recharge the highlighted enchanted weapon with a soul gem

Favorites.Up: Move the selection up in the Favorites list
Favorites.Down: Move the selection down in the Favorites list
Favorites.LeftEquip: Equip the highlighted favorite in the left hand
Favorites.RightEquip: Equip the highlighted favorite in the right hand

Map.Accept: Select the marker under the cursor (fast travel)
Map.Click: Select the marker under the cursor (fast travel)
Map.MapLookMode: Hold to rotate / tilt the map camera
Map.PlayerPosition: Center the map on the player
Map.LocalMap: Switch between the world map and the local map
Map.LocalMapMoveMode: Hold to drag the local map
Map.PlacePlayerMarker: Place or remove your custom marker
Map.Journal: Open the quest Journal from the map

Stats.Rotate: Turn to the next / previous skill constellation
Stats.Cancel: Leave the perk tree / close the Skills menu

Journal.XButton: Tab action: delete save / show quest on the map / reset setting
Journal.YButton: Tab action: toggle quest objectives / character info

TFC.LockToZPlane: Free camera: keep the current height

Lockpicking.RotateLock: Turn the lock: try to open it at the current pick position

Marketplace.Up: Move up in the Creation Club menu
Marketplace.Down: Move down in the Creation Club menu
Marketplace.Left: Move left in the Creation Club menu
Marketplace.Right: Move right in the Creation Club menu
Marketplace.Accept: Open / confirm in the Creation Club menu
Marketplace.Cancel: Back / close the Creation Club menu

Favor.Activate: Give the order: move here, use or attack what you look at

Any.Dual Attack: Attack with both hands at once
Any.NextFocus: Move focus to the next panel
Any.PreviousFocus: Move focus to the previous panel
Any.ToggleFavorite: Add or remove the highlighted item from Favorites
Any.XButton: Context button (the action depends on the open menu)
Any.YButton: Context button (the action depends on the open menu)
Any.Take All: Take every item from the container
Any.SetActiveQuest: Make the highlighted quest the active one

Mouse.Look: Look around / rotate the camera with the mouse
Mouse.Cursor: Move the menu cursor with the mouse

Gamepad.Look: Look around / rotate the camera (right stick)

quickSlots.use: Use quick slot {0} (item or spell assigned in the Favorites menu)
quickSlots.favorites: Assign the highlighted favorite to quick slot {0}
